description: Source code implementing bit operations for Redis, including functions for bit counting, bit position finding, and bit manipulation commands such as GETBIT, SETBIT, BITCOUNT, and BITOP.

methods.name: getBitOffsetFromArgument
methods.description: Parses the bit offset argument, ensuring it is a valid integer within range, and returns it via pointer.

methods.name: redisPopcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a binary array, supporting input up to 512 MB.

methods.name: redisBitpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first bit set to 1 or 0 in a bitmap within a specified range.

methods.name: setbitCommand
methods.description: Handles the SETBIT command, setting or clearing a specific bit in a key.

methods.name: getbitCommand
methods.description: Handles the GETBIT command, retrieving the value of a specific bit in a key.

methods.name: bitopCommand
methods.description: Performs bitwise operations (AND, OR, XOR, NOT) on multiple keys and stores the result.

methods.name: bitcountCommand
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a key, optionally within a specified range.

methods.name: bitposCommand
methods.description: Finds the position of the first bit set to 1 or 0 in a key, optionally within a range.
